note: Everything the splats page loads. fetch-assets.mjs downloads each url into assets/<path> and checks bytes and sha256; vendor libs are pinned jsDelivr URLs; marble-* are World Labs' public example exports, used only as a reference. The day pano worlds (local: true, no url) are built on this machine from the shared GMI pano by the entry's build command (CPU MoGe-2, about 60 s per day) because the spike has no public bucket for its own .spz files; fetch-assets.mjs --build runs those commands.
